name: approved-session-style

dialogue.wrapping: Phrase-aware manual breaks. Fit to the actual bubble cavity. No automatic hyphenation.

prose.note: Keep the original commentary art, with English in the right margin. Check ink color against the pale background.

credits.note: Use neutral book typography, aligned columns and compact notices. Copy the layout into available blank space when appropriate.

effects.ordinary: Anime Ace, horizontal lettering with original outline retained
effects.artistic: Preserve distinctive Japanese action lettering and add a short nearby English subtitle
effects.gradient: Use a soft white glow beneath the English. Do not fake the gradient or invent a balloon.
effects.symbol_protection: Keep hearts, signatures, intentional marks and censor bars.

cleanup.white_balloon: Native white fill inside the original outline, including square narration boxes
cleanup.art_background: Native constrained masks and paste layers. Inspect at full size.
cleanup.check: Look for source glyph fragments, dots, seams, gray smudges and double outlines around and below new text.

fonts: Resolve fonts from the submodule or OS. Verify the actual font before rendering. Do not silently substitute.
precedence: Per-page reviewed native layouts override these defaults. This profile preserves a preference, not identical font sizes across different source resolutions.
